{{Quote|We always know when the Tusken Raiders are on a killing spree. We can hear their rifles cracking across the desert like lightning strikes.|Huff Darklighter|<ref name="neg">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Cycler rifles''' were the standard projectile weapon used by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in ranged combat. Varying in design, cycler rifles were often homemade creations or pieced together through scavenged starship wrecks, smelted metals, and other gathered refuse.<ref name="FF" /> A long-range weapon, cycler rifles made use of a limited [[Magnetic pulse accelerator]] to propel solid ammunition through the rifle's long and sturdy barrel, giving the weapon impressive range and stopping power.<ref name="FF" /> Ammunition was mainly limited to generic [[slugthrower]] rounds, though in rare cases tribes acquired explosive slugs,<ref name="FF" /> which when fired were enveloped in an energy sheath. The weapon emitted a unique sound when fired, rather like a cross between a blaster and a [[musket]].

==Description==
[[File:Tusken_Rifle.png|thumb|left|250px|A Tusken Raider taking aim at podracers in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]]]
The Tusken Raiders generally modified their rifles, as the basic variant lacked the targeting tools necessary to make the rifle an effective sniping weapon. The weapons were normally modified with improved firing chambers for larger and more powerful slugs or the addition of [[Scope/Legends|scopes]] for better sniping.

The rifles were similar to the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]-produced [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle/Legends|6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]], so it is possible that the raiders stole shipments of these weapons and modified them for their own use. The raiders liked nothing better than camping out near the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] track during a race and taking pot shots at the pods as they zoomed past. The number of racers lost in this way was a testament to Tusken accuracy.

[[File:Tatooine_Hunting_Rifle_IATS.png|thumb|right|250px|A Tusken firing his cycler rifle]]
The length of the barrel gave the Cycler better accuracy than more contemporary [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] designs, with the very best models being able to hit human-sized targets from distances up to 1000 meters. The rate of fire was fairly slow, as many of the rifles used a bolt action mechanism. As a result, Tusken Cyclers were not used at short ranges where a fast rate of fire was necessary. Rather, they were used to pick off enemies at long range. The Raiders retained the [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaffi stick]] for dealing with enemies in close combat.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]] refers to these weapons as "[[Laser rifle/Legends|laser rifles]]," but this seems to be contradicted by later literature as Tusken Cyclers are depicted as slugthrowers in ''The Phantom Menace''.

The appearance and purpose of the weapon is based on the real-world [[Wikipedia:Jezail|jezail]], long-barreled muskets used by Pashtun tribesmen against British colonial troops.
